prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one production-ready desktop web application design comp, rendered as a straight-on screenshot at exactly 1500 × 1050 pixels.
Primary request: Design Alloc's approved ‘Quiet Operator’ redesign, composition option C: inspector-first. This is a dense operational financial intelligence workspace, not a marketing page. Linear-inspired in discipline and interaction quality but clearly original, with no copied branding or trade dress.

Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed app UI on a warm crisp light-gray canvas. A muted charcoal left sidebar, a compact top command/search header, a broad central financial overview, and a persistent right inspector. No browser chrome and no device frame.

Composition/framing:
- Canvas 1500 × 1050, straight-on, pixel-sharp, fully designed to all edges.
- Left sidebar about 205 px wide in muted charcoal. Small ‘Alloc’ wordmark at top; compact navigation: Overview selected, Requests with a tiny ‘1’ badge, Memory, Forecast, Activity. A ‘Companies’ section lists Northstar selected, Juniper Table, Forge & Loom. Bottom status: ‘Local model · Ready’.
- Main app to the right. A 48 px compact header bar spans above the work area, separated by hairline borders. Include a command/search field reading ‘Search memory or run a command…’ with ‘⌘ K’, then compact controls ‘Northstar Fieldworks’, ‘Review scenario’, and a small green ‘Mock API connected’ status.
- Below header, divide remaining width into a broad central work surface around 770 px and a persistent inspector around 500 px. The inspector is visually attached to the right edge with a strong but restrained vertical divider and a tiny collapse chevron.
- Central title row: ‘Northstar Fieldworks’, then small metadata ‘Q3 2026 · As of Sep 12, 2026 · SYNTHETIC MOCK DATA’.
- Central financial overview should dominate: a single continuous bordered work surface, not a grid of decorative floating cards. Header ‘Company exposure’ and ‘Canonical organization total’. Four exact aligned columns with tabular numerals: ‘Authorized $500.00’ caption ‘Binding hard cap’; ‘Recognized $120.00’ caption ‘Posted’; ‘Committed $210.00’ caption ‘Outstanding’; ‘Available $170.00’ caption ‘Headroom’. Beneath, a precise thin segmented allocation bar and legend.
- Then a dense section ‘Field engineering scope’ with a subtle outlined chip ‘NON-ADDITIVE VIEW’ and exact helper text ‘Scoped view of canonical records — do not add to company total.’ Show a compact table with rows: Travel $48.00 $115.50; Cloud services $42.00 $63.00; Field equipment $30.00 $31.50. Columns: Category, Recognized, Committed.
- Lower center: compact ‘Forecast horizon’ with ‘Projected through Sep 30, 2026’ and exact total ‘$300.00’, plus rows ‘Actual spend $120.00’ and ‘Outstanding commitment $180.00’. Include ‘Deterministic mock calculation · no model arithmetic.’
- Persistent right inspector title bar: ‘Request inspector’, subtle status badge ‘PENDING’, collapse chevron, close icon. Add small subtitle ‘Buffalo Beacon pilot trip · Revision 3’.
- Inspector is a clear vertical four-stage workflow with a thin left step rail and numbered nodes, reading exactly ‘1 Request’, ‘2 Policy’, ‘3 Evidence’, ‘4 Decision’. Show all four stages expanded but compact.
- Request stage: Maya Chen; revised total $240.00; cumulative change +$60.00; submitted Sep 12, 2026 · 2:02 PM.
- Policy stage: amber restrained warning line ‘Cumulative amendment limit exceeded’; helper copy ‘Request remains at its last approved exposure until a human decides.’
- Evidence stage: two dense provenance rows: ‘Active trip authorization’ and ‘Budget authorized amount · $500.00’, each with small tags ‘synthetic’, ‘authoritative’, ‘source_mock_simulator’. Include ‘Evidence informs context. It does not grant spending authority.’
- Decision stage: outlined secondary button ‘Decline’, solid charcoal primary button ‘Review and approve →’, and footer ‘Authenticated human decision · mock-backed’.
- A slim footer across center: ‘This is synthetic, mock-backed data. Not real financial data.’ and ‘scenario_mock_northstar_v1’.

Style/medium: High-fidelity modern SaaS desktop UI screenshot. Humanist sans throughout (Inter-like but not branded); tabular numerals; compact 12–14 px body typography; firm typographic hierarchy without huge display text. Warm light gray #F5F4F1 canvas, off-white #FBFAF8 work surfaces, charcoal #252725 sidebar, ink #272A27, muted text #737872, cool hairlines #D9DAD6. Very restrained green for connected/verified, amber only for pending warning, red only if needed for destructive action. Square to 6 px corners. Mostly flat surfaces, near-zero shadows. Dense and calm, exact, trustworthy, accessible contrast.

Subtle state transitions represented in a static comp: active nav uses a quiet filled row and thin indicator; inspector step nodes show completed/current hierarchy; buttons and disclosure controls look interactive; use a tiny muted transition hint near the inspector divider such as ‘Details synced’.

Text (verbatim): ‘Alloc’; ‘Overview’; ‘Requests’; ‘Memory’; ‘Forecast’; ‘Activity’; ‘Northstar Fieldworks’; ‘Search memory or run a command…’; ‘SYNTHETIC MOCK DATA’; ‘Company exposure’; ‘Canonical organization total’; ‘Authorized’; ‘$500.00’; ‘Recognized’; ‘$120.00’; ‘Committed’; ‘$210.00’; ‘Available’; ‘$170.00’; ‘Field engineering scope’; ‘NON-ADDITIVE VIEW’; ‘Scoped view of canonical records — do not add to company total.’; ‘Forecast horizon’; ‘$300.00’; ‘Request inspector’; ‘PENDING’; ‘Buffalo Beacon pilot trip’; ‘Revision 3’; ‘Request’; ‘Policy’; ‘Evidence’; ‘Decision’; ‘Maya Chen’; ‘$240.00’; ‘+$60.00’; ‘Cumulative amendment limit exceeded’; ‘Review and approve’; ‘Synthetic mock data’; ‘This is synthetic, mock-backed data. Not real financial data.’

Constraints: All exact financial values and named text must be legible and correct. Financial work surface is visually dominant. Inspector is persistent and clearly collapsible. Make the layout feel plausible for a real shipping React application. Use no logos other than the simple Alloc wordmark and no third-party branding.
Avoid: field-ledger paper; punched holes; binder holes; handwriting; serif finance display; paper or material metaphors; physical textures; noise; gradients; glassmorphism; neon; glow; skeuomorphism; decorative card grid; rounded pill overload; oversized hero metrics; generic analytics dashboard; copied Linear branding; dark main canvas; floating browser window; perspective; people; illustrations; charts that imply additive scope totals; illegible or invented financial values; watermarks.
